stories.text: St Helen's was given its clerestory towards the end of the 15th century. Its monuments include Robert Tevery, who died in 1571, and Gervase Tevery, who died in 1639. A classical porch was added in 1785, the church was restored in 1875–77, and a memorial chapel came in 1923. It is listed Grade II*.

110571.sum: St. Helen's Church Stapleford is a parish church in the Church of England in Stapleford, Nottinghamshire. The church is Grade II* listed by the Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport as it is a particularly significant building of more than local interest.
